terra.problem: Saying David became king later assumes when this cave prayer took place. The psalm does not date it, and 2 Samuel 5:3 does not establish the timing of this cave.
The joke refers to Papa Dorin being stuck somewhere without identifying the drawer, so a baker unfamiliar with his story lacks the setup.
Saying David does not hide a thing and pours out the whole cup goes beyond his statement that he reveals his trouble.
Saying David holds nothing back and reveals whatever is weighing on him goes beyond what he says about revealing his trouble.
The explanation states why the snare was hidden, but David does not give that reason.
The explanation specifies that the snare was waiting for a foot, but the psalm does not describe the kind of snare.
David says no one attends to him, not that he is physically alone.
Saying nobody is standing there at all goes beyond David's statement that no one attends to him.
The explanation asserts that the spot beside David is empty, which the psalm does not say. It also places his mighty men later than this prayer, though the passage does not date the cave.
The claim about David's mighty men is a Bible fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
Saying David was a king later assumes the timing of the cave prayer, which the psalm does not establish.
The psalm mentions pursuers but does not say they are around David in the cave.
The explanation presents being shut in and wanting a door opened as what David means, rather than marking that reading of prison as Papa Dorin's own.
David says the righteous will gather, but the text does not establish that none of his pursuers could be among them.
